the risk of incident diabetes is increased in euthyroid individuals with an increase in serum TSH level.

thyroid function, especially thyroid-stimulating-hormone concentration, is a modifiable risk factor of diabetes.

the thyroid gland may be involved in the pathophysiology of type 2 DM.

thyroid-stimulating hormones are associated with diabetes risk in euthyroid individuals.
